paper_metadata.title: High-temperature fatigue properties of austenitic superalloys 718, A286 and 304L

evidence.quote: The alloys 718 and A286 are precipitation-hardening type austenitic superalloys
Alloys 718 [1,2] and A286 [3] are typical austenitic superalloys of the precipitation-hardening type, which are nickel-based and iron-based, respectively.
